ACCEPT — scoped client-contract review at `2860d8593f90e1a327ac86cee0ef313d94692489`.

Reviewed the status/sharing/demo/readAt production delta at `5b3fadc9167baac2d1cb91720e650a1a0b901e4f`. Fresh checks there passed: 89 author native tests, 16 actual-controller fixture checks with synthetic HTTP, 3 frozen-foundation compile checks, both strict TypeScript configurations, 68 independent checks and 5 actual signed HTTP/PostgreSQL checks. The independent cases cover all five required root readAt fields, source/privacy projections, explicit sharing replay, anonymous demo acquisition, selected-persona verification, refusals, retired replies and expiry bounds. Synthetic JWT claims alone never establish authentication.

The current head changes only runtime.integration.mjs and documentation; the production API tree is byte-identical (`c0198b1dddc2c884c43637cc0082350956498d07`). Independently inspected that delta and freshly executed its real HTTP/PostgreSQL suite: 7 passed, 0 failed. Separate signed synthetic issuers reject each other's tokens in BOTH directions; a real verifier401 clears the verified memory session, gateway and bound controller context. Owned PostgreSQL16.14 port56447 was cleaned up. Unchanged earlier unit/compile/independent inputs were not rerun just for this test-only head.

Contract pins remain backend PR74 `4c138ca1d00742400a850cd72b0888cc59260a36`, owner reads PR65 `3ea6e1b06e6dc3d3d01360f28ae9c61751657830`, and temporary resource helper `c2501a40253b50b1406371f8fd7ebeaf309ec00c`. This is an explicit temporary test composition, not a backend merge. Independent evidence is preserved in PR55 commit `76e0ae5`.

No blocking client finding. This verdict does not approve backend policy timing/auth/privacy, browser/CORS/device/provider behavior, or whole-app acceptance; those retain their separate owners and source pins. PR59/7e and the older API78/backendebc bridge evidence remain unchanged. Q44 owns integration.
